# Lawes Company

> > Lawes Company is a family-owned New Jersey HVAC contractor, heating oil and fuel delivery service, and standby generator installer serving Monmouth and Ocean Counties.

Based in Shrewsbury, Lawes Company provides comprehensive home comfort solutions including residential heating and cooling systems, automatic fuel delivery (heating oil, propane, diesel), oil tank services, standby generators, and outdoor equipment sales. The company combines HVAC expertise with fuel services and home comfort maintenance plans.
